# Duck Data Platform Docs

> AI-first product documentation for users, admins, builders, and agents.

## Core docs

- [Architecture Governance](/architecture-governance): Engineering governance rules for the codebase and architecture boundaries.
- [Browser-Local Compute Runbook](/browser-local-compute): Current browser-local DuckDB WASM execution model, limitations, and support expectations.
- [Platform Objects and Governance](/core-concepts/access-control): Understand the objects users consume and the governance layers that shape visibility.
- [Query and Compute](/core-concepts/compute-and-query): Understand how query execution, routing, and worker boundaries fit together for platform users.
- [Declarative Workflows](/core-concepts/declarative): Understand the declarative model, schema validation, and desired-state workflows.
- [Build Data Products](/core-concepts/index): Learn the objects and workflows behind governed data products in Duck.
- [Manage Access](/how-to/access-control): Create secure access paths with groups, grants, row filters, and column masks.
- [Access the Platform](/how-to/authentication): Understand the main sign-in and credential paths available to platform users.
- [Author Notebooks and Publish Dashboards](/how-to/author-notebooks-and-publish-dashboards): Create notebooks, execute analysis, and publish dashboards backed by notebook, SQL, or semantic outputs.
- [Build and Run Models and Pipelines](/how-to/build-and-run-model-pipelines): Define transformation logic, validate model outputs, and orchestrate repeatable pipeline runs.
- [Load Data and Build Assets](/how-to/catalog-and-ingestion): Bring data into Duck and build tables, models, views, and other reusable assets.
- [Work Declaratively](/how-to/declarative-workflows): Use validate-plan-apply workflows to manage platform state as code.
- [Define Semantic Metrics](/how-to/define-semantic-metrics): Build semantic models, metrics, and relationships that agents and users can query consistently.
- [Use Duck](/how-to/index): Complete common product tasks with expected outcomes and next steps.
- [Query and Explore Data](/how-to/use-the-cli): Discover catalogs, inspect objects, and query data through Duck's available access surfaces.
- [Duck Data Platform](/index): Product documentation for people and AI agents using Duck across querying, governance, and data product workflows.
- [Platform Settings](/operations/configuration): Use Duck's platform settings safely in shared and production environments.
- [Distributed Compute](/operations/distributed-compute): Operate remote compute while keeping control-plane enforcement centralized.
- [Administration](/operations/index): Manage access, security, platform settings, and distributed compute safely.
- [Security Checklist](/operations/security-checklist): Review the minimum controls to run Duck in a shared or production environment.
- [Advanced API Reference](/reference/api): Use the generated API reference when you need exact interface detail.
- [Advanced CLI Reference](/reference/cli): Use the CLI when your organization exposes command-line workflows and you need command-level detail.
- [Advanced Declarative Reference](/reference/declarative): Use the generated declarative schema reference when you need field-level schema detail.
- [Assets and Lineage](/reference/feature-assets-and-lineage): Use this feature guide for governed assets, checks, runs, and lineage inspection.
- [Catalogs and Governance](/reference/feature-catalogs-and-governance): Use this feature guide for catalogs, schemas, views, grants, row filters, and column masks.
- [Identity and Authentication](/reference/feature-identity-and-auth): Use this feature guide for sign-in, principals, groups, and API key workflows.
- [Models and Pipelines](/reference/feature-models-and-pipelines): Use this feature guide for models, macros, model runs, and pipeline orchestration workflows.
- [Notebooks and Dashboards](/reference/feature-notebooks-and-dashboards): Use this feature guide for notebook authoring, notebook jobs, and dashboard publishing workflows.
- [Query and Compute](/reference/feature-query-and-compute): Use this feature guide for query execution, async queries, compute endpoints, and health checks.
- [Semantic Layer](/reference/feature-semantic-layer): Use this feature guide for semantic models, metrics, relationships, and metric query execution.
- [Storage and Integrations](/reference/feature-storage-and-integrations): Use this feature guide for storage credentials, external locations, and external system integrations.
- [Glossary](/reference/glossary): Shared terminology for the platform, API, declarative config, and operations guides.
- [Reference](/reference/index): Start with product guidance and use advanced reference only when necessary.
- [Ways to Access Duck](/start-here/deployment-modes): Understand the main access paths for users, builders, and admins.
- [Getting Started](/start-here/index): Understand what Duck is, who it is for, and how platform users begin.
- [Quickstart](/start-here/quickstart): Access Duck, choose an auth path, and run a first secure query.
